messages:
Emma (Marketing): Quick check - we need final CTA behavior for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages today. Single hero, 3 CTAs. Thoughts?
Noah (Content): Agree on single hero. Proposed microcopy: Hosted = 'Start for free', Dedicated = 'Reserve capacity', Private = 'Request a private trial'.
Priya (Design): I'll design stacked CTAs for mobile. Also suggest adding a tiny mode label above each CTA (HOSTED / DEDICATED / PRIVATE) so users scan faster.
Jason (Growth): Routing: Hosted -> signup funnel (utm_content=hosted). Dedicated -> SDR lead (tag=dedicated). Private -> enterprise queue + compliance flag.
Liam (Product): Add a form checkbox: 'Contains regulated data (requires private deployment)'. Auto-route if checked. Keep Dedicated form to 3 fields only.
Noah (Content): For the hero line options: 1) 'Production LLM inference — hosted, dedicated, or private.' 2) 'Ship ML features with predictable latency, cost controls, and isolation.' Leaning toward 2 but shorter.
Emma (Marketing): Let's test both in staging. Also benchmark ribbon under hero: 'Optimized for latency and cost — see benchmarks' linking to the benchmark post.
Priya (Design): Done — ribbon will be a subtle pill. Where should webinar CTA live? Under ribbon or as a separate banner?
Jason (Growth): Banner under ribbon works. CTA: 'Join webinar — live benchmarks & migration tips'. Track via utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch.
oncall-bot: Reminder: marketing staging deploy scheduled in 2 hours.
Emma (Marketing): Perfect. Action items: Noah finalizes hero copy (1pm), Priya delivers mocks (EOD), Liam wires routing rules (48h), Jason sets UTM/CRM mappings (today).
